Universal garage-door opener, floor mats, and thoughtful details like no-dazzle high-beam assistance round out an already complete luxury experience.

The 19-inch double-arm design wheels in matte titanium finish deliver both style and capability.

Safety and convenience merge throughout the vehicle, with features including the Top View Camera System for enhanced visibility, adaptive cruise assist to reduce driver fatigue, and a comprehensive airbag system. The panoramic power moonroof opens your connection to the sky, bathing the cabin in natural light.

This 2023 Audi Q3 represents a compelling choice for discerning drivers seeking quality, technology, and performance. We invite you to experience it in person and discover why this vehicle deserves serious consideration.

A leather-wrapped steering wheel, steering wheel-mounted audio controls, illuminated entry, and multiple interior storage areas make this Ram comfortable and practical for everyday use.

The 2010 Ferrari California represents a landmark chapter in the marque s history, combining unmistakable Italian performance with the comfort and versatility of a sophisticated grand tourer. Its power-operated retractable hardtop allows it to transition seamlessly from a refined coupe to an exhilarating open-air sports car, making it one of Ferrari s most usable and accomplished modern classics.
Beneath the sculpted hood lies a naturally aspirated 4.3-liter direct-injected V8 producing 453 horsepower, paired with Ferrari s lightning-quick seven-speed dual-clutch transmission. Capable of accelerating from 0 60 mph in approximately four seconds and reaching a top speed of nearly 193 mph, the California delivers breathtaking performance accompanied by the unmistakable soundtrack of a high-revving Ferrari V8.
The California was also a model of important firsts for Ferrari: the company s first front-engine V8 road car, first production model with a seven-speed dual-clutch transmission, and first to feature a fully retractable metal roof. Its front-mid-engine configuration, F1-Trac traction-management system and carbon-ceramic brakes provide genuine Ferrari performance, while its comfortable cabin and grand-touring character make it equally suited to spirited drives or extended journeys.
This CARFAX-certified four-owner example has no accidents or damage reported or detectable. It has spent its entire life in the western United States, beginning in Washington before moving to the Las Vegas area and later Salt Lake City. Its long-term western provenance and evident careful stewardship have contributed to its impressive condition today.

Daytona-style seats

Scuderia Ferrari fender shields
Power-retractable hardtop
Black painted wheels
